title: Odd Lots: Why Private Credit Got Entangled With Insurance
title_cn: 奇怪的事情：为什么私人信贷与保险纠缠在一起
summary:
Insurers have quietly become a major driver of the private credit boom, changing the insurance industry itself and raising a number of questions about risk and regulation.

Andrew Granato and Pranjal Drall, authors of a new paper, “Private Credit's State Backstop: How Private Equity Socializes Risk Through Insurers," tell Tracy Alloway and Joe Weisenthal how both sides benefit from the partnership and why taxpayers might ultimately be on the hook. (Source: Bloomberg)

title_cn: 彭博社监测 2026 年 7 月 31 日

title_cn: 由于诺和诺德 (Novo Nordisk) 和 UMG 暴跌，欧洲股市削减月度涨幅
summary: European shares erased Friday’s gains, as Novo Nordisk A/S slumped after a failed drug study and Universal Music Group NV sank to a record low on disappointing earnings.

title: US Treasury Weighs Repo Entry That Could Reshape Funding Markets

summary: The US Treasury is exploring bringing some of its cash pile into the roughly $13 trillion market for repurchase agreements, reviving a two-decade old idea and sparking a debate around its potential to reshape a key part of the financial system’s plumbing.

title: Latest Oil Market News and Analysis for July 31
title_cn: 7 月 31 日最新石油市场新闻和分析
summary: Oil climbed as traders wrestled with threats to supply from the Persian Gulf to the Black Sea, leading some traders to layer on risk ahead of the weekend.

title: NY Sues Kalshi for Running an ‘Illegal Gambling’ Operation
title_cn: 纽约州起诉卡尔希经营“非法赌博”业务
summary: New York state authorities sued the predictions-market company Kalshi Inc. for allegedly running an illegal, unlicensed gambling operation in the state, marking another legal hurdle for an industry that has won support from the Trump administration.

title: Jane Street-Backed Exchange Sells Control to Canada’s TMX Group
title_cn: Jane Street 支持的交易所将控制权出售给加拿大 TMX 集团
summary: MEMX LLC, an exchange operator backed by Jane Street and Morgan Stanley, will combine with equity options market BOX in a deal that gives control of the merged entity to Canada’s leading stock exchange group.

title: Kenya Inflation Tops Target Midpoint for Fourth Month
title_cn: 肯尼亚通胀连续第四个月高于目标中点
summary: Kenya’s annual inflation rate exceeded the midpoint of the central bank’s target range for a fourth month, as energy costs fueled price growth.

title: Exxon, Chevron Steer Windfall Profits Into Paying Down Debt
title_cn: 埃克森美孚和雪佛龙利用巨额利润偿还债务
summary: ExxonMobil Holdings Corp. and Chevron Corp. plowed blowout profits into debt reduction rather than huge buyback increases in a sign of Big Oil’s caution about how long war-driven price rallies will last.

title: Reddit Shares Plunge by Record on Dearth of New AI Deals
title_cn: 由于缺乏新的人工智能交易，Reddit 股价暴跌创历史新高
summary: Reddit Inc. shares suffered their worst intraday drop ever after the social media company failed to announce any new data licensing agreements in its latest earnings report, disappointing investors who are hoping to see a shift in revenue streams.

title: US Consumer Sentiment Rises to Five-Month High
title_cn: 美国消费者信心升至五个月高位
summary: The University of Michigan’s final July sentiment index increased to 55.2 this month, according to the survey released Friday. That's an improvement from the preliminary estimate of 54.4. Michael McKee reports on "Bloomberg Open Interest." (Source: Bloomberg)

title: Ishihara: All Eyes On Indication for Next BOJ Hike
title_cn: 石原慎太郎：所有人都关注日本央行下次加息的迹象
summary: The Bank of Japan has kept its rate policy unchanged and nudged its economic growth forecast higher. Officials stop short of confirming an intervention that drove the yen sharply higher. Hiromi Ishihara, Head of equity investment at Amundi Japan told Bloomberg’s Abeer Abu Omar on Horizons Middle East & Africa what investors are watching out for. (Source: Bloomberg)

title: Citadel Swoops Into Hedge Fund Crisis
title_cn: Citadel 陷入对冲基金危机
summary: A heavily leveraged AI hedge fund unraveled after volatile stocks triggered margin calls and a frantic asset sale. Bloomberg’s Hema Parmar joined Bloomberg Open Interest to explain how Situational Awareness scrambled for buyers before Ken Griffin’s Citadel stepped in. (Source: Bloomberg)

title: Situational Awareness Losses Raise AI Fears
title_cn: 态势感知能力丧失引发人工智能恐惧
summary: Assets at Leopold Aschenbrenner’s hedge fund Situational Awareness have slumped to about $10 billion after Ken Griffin’s Citadel stepped in to buy the bulk of its public stock bets. Hema Parmar has more on "Bloomberg Open Interest." (Source: Bloomberg)

title: Universal Music Group Record Low; Roblox Slumps  | Stock Movers
title_cn: 环球音乐集团创历史新低； Roblox 暴跌 |库存搬运工
summary:
On this episode of Stock Movers:

- Universal Music Group (UMG NA) plummeted to their lowest level since listing, after the company reported disappointing subscription revenue growth. The world’s largest record label’s subscription revenues grew 16.6% in constant currency, including the impact of its purchase of Downtown Music Holdings, but analysts had expected a 19.2% increase.

- Roblox (RBLX) shares are lower after the video-game company’s second-quarter results disappointed on key metrics, including users and hours engaged. It also gave a forecast for both bookings and revenue that was weaker than expected.
- Reddit (RDDT) shares are moving after it projected revenue in the current quarter revenue that beat Wall Street estimates, but shares fell after the social media company failed to announce any new data licensing agreements. (Source: Bloomberg)

title: Combining Tesla and SpaceX Makes 'A Ton of Sense' Says Munster
title_cn: 蒙斯特表示，特斯拉和 SpaceX 的结合“意义重大”
summary:
Tesla Inc. is weighing a potential separation of its China business to pave the way for a possible merger with SpaceX, according to the Wall Street Journal.
Separating Tesla's China operations would be a complex undertaking due to the auto factory's deep embedding in China's electric vehicle supply chain and its role in supplying vehicles to markets worldwide.
 Gene Munster, Managing Partner at Deepwater Asset Management, joins Bloomberg Intelligence to discuss Tesla as well as to break down Apple's earnings. (Source: Bloomberg)

title: AI Has Reached an Inflection Point
title_cn: 人工智能已达到拐点
summary: Lei Qiu, chief investment officer of thematic innovation equities at AllianceBernstein, says AI has reached an inflection point as the focus shifts from infrastructure investment to revenue generation. "We see revenue accelerating," she says, adding that continued adoption is critical. "As long as we see that, I think the ecosystem remains healthy." She speaks on "Bloomberg Surveillance." (Source: Bloomberg)

title: Telus Cuts Payout Under New CEO; Shares Tumble to 2011 Levels
title_cn: Telus在新任首席执行官领导下削减支出；股价跌至 2011 年水平
summary: Canadian communications company Telus Corp. slashed its dividend by 55% and will try to unload assets, including parts of its health division, as new CEO Victor Dodig looks to repair the balance sheet.

title: Amazon AWS Growth, AI Demand Buoy 2Q Results
title_cn: 亚马逊 AWS 增长、人工智能需求提振第二季度业绩
summary: Anurag Rana, Senior Tech Analyst with Bloomberg Intelligence, breaks down Amazon and Apple earnings from his latest outlook report: Post-2Q Earnings Outlook: Accelerating AI demand and stronger retail execution can keep Amazon.com's underlying momentum intact despite softer 3Q sales guidance tied partly to the Prime Day shift. The company's 2Q results showed broad-based strength, with Amazon Web Services, retail and advertising all outperforming expectations. Faster delivery and AI-powered shopping are also strengthening customer engagement. We expect Amazon Web Services sales growth to remain at or above 35% in 2H, supported by persistent AI demand and higher backlog. Amazon raised its 2026 cash-capital-outlay outlook to $220 billion from $200 billion because of higher memory prices. (Source: Bloomberg)

title: Jana Adds More Sale Pressure on Alkami in Board Letter
title_cn: Jana 在董事会信函中加大了对 Alkami 的销售压力
summary: Activist investor Jana Partners contends Alkami Technology Inc. is failing to run a true sale process, according to a new letter to the fintech company’s board that was reviewed by Bloomberg News.

title: Why Texas Is Winning the Space Race
title_cn: 为什么德克萨斯州赢得太空竞赛
summary: Already home to SpaceX, Blue Origin and recent moon-landers Firefly Aerospace and Intuitive Machines, Texas is quickly becoming the center of the commercial space universe. Through a newly-formed agency, Texas officials have been doling out grants for space-related research, projects and emerging technology. So what does this mean for the "Lone Star State?" And why has it become such a proving ground for the startups of the future? (Corrects map of Texas throughout video.)  (Source: Bloomberg)

title: Apple Battles Chip Shortages
title_cn: 苹果解决芯片短缺问题
summary: Apple may be battling chip shortages, rising memory costs, and margin pressure, but demand remains remarkably strong. Baird analyst Will Power joins Bloomberg Open Interest to explain why investors should look through near-term supply turbulence, highlighting surging Mac sales, resilient iPhone growth, pricing power, and AI-driven product catalysts. (Source: Bloomberg)

title: AI Wunderkind’s Hedge Fund Unravels
title_cn: 人工智能神童的对冲基金揭秘
summary: A 24-year-old AI wunderkind became one of the market’s most influential investors, until leverage and margin calls forced billions in tech-stock sales. Bloomberg's Sri Natarajan joined Bloomberg Open Interest to explain how a futuristic AI empire collided with one of Wall Street’s oldest and most dangerous mistakes. (Source: Bloomberg)

title: Amazon, Microsoft Show That AI Spending Spree Remains Solid
title_cn: 亚马逊和微软表明人工智能支出热潮依然强劲
summary: Aggressive AI spending plans by Amazon.com Inc., Microsoft Corp. and Alphabet Inc. provided fresh evidence that demand for chips and related equipment will remain strong, offering relief to a sector that’s been battered in recent days.

title: Amazon’s Trillion-Dollar AWS AI Bet
title_cn: 亚马逊价值数万亿美元的 AWS AI 赌注
summary: Amazon’s AI spending is beginning to deliver measurable results. TD Cowen Analyst John Blackledge joined Bloomberg Open Interest to explain why soaring AWS demand could keep Amazon capacity-constrained through 2027, how the cloud division could eventually reach $1 trillion in revenue, and why Andy Jassy’s AI message is resonating more strongly with investors than Meta’s. (Source: Bloomberg)

title: Situational Awareness Hit by AI Selloff
title_cn: 态势感知受到人工智能抛售的打击
summary: Situational Awareness, Leopold Aschenbrenner's hedge fund, was forced to sell billions of dollars of technology investments that had rapidly lost value, as nervous banks began to demand more collateral for his trades. Ken Griffin's Citadel hedge fund reached out to Situational Awareness and snapped up the investments at a discount, according to a person familiar with the matter. Bloomberg's Anthony Stephens reports. (Source: Bloomberg)

title: Proto Labs Lifts Guidance on New Data Center, Defense Clients
title_cn: Proto Labs 取消对新数据中心、国防客户的指导
summary: Automated manufacturing company Proto Labs Inc. raised its full-year outlook after earnings reached a seven-year high, helped by renewed strength in its injection molding business and new data center and defense customers.

title: Moonshot’s Kimi Uses 20,000 Nvidia Chip Cluster From Alibaba
title_cn: Moonshot 的 Kimi 使用阿里巴巴的 20,000 个 Nvidia 芯片集群
summary: Chinese AI champion Moonshot has a computing power agreement with Alibaba Group Holding Ltd. for the use of around 20,000 Nvidia Corp. chips, underscoring China’s continued reliance on Western semiconductors to fuel its AI development, according to people with knowledge of the companies’ operations.

title: Roblox Shares Slump on Safety-Measures Impact, Weak Forecast
title_cn: Roblox 股价因安全措施影响而暴跌，预测疲软
summary: Roblox Corp. shares tumbled by as much as 26% as trading got underway in New York, the largest intraday decline in roughly four-and-a-half years, after the gaming company reported second-quarter daily active users that missed analysts’ expectations, reflecting the ongoing impact of new child-safety measures.

title: Amazon Shares Soar After Fifth Quarter of Cloud Sales Growth
title_cn: 第五季度云销售增长后亚马逊股价飙升
summary: Amazon.com Inc. shares surged after the company reported cloud-computing revenue accelerated for a fifth straight quarter, easing investors’ concerns that it won’t produce a return on huge expenditures to meet the booming demand for artificial intelligence.

title: Apple Slides Most Since 2025 After Supply Shortages Hurt Outlook
title_cn: 供应短缺影响前景，苹果股价自 2025 年以来跌幅最大
summary: Apple Inc. tumbled by the most in 16 months after component shortages weighed on the company’s sales forecast, signaling that industrywide supply constraints are taking a bigger toll than anticipated.

title: Ares CEO on Earnings, AI Deployment, Private Credit
title_cn: Ares 首席执行官谈盈利、人工智能部署、私人信贷
summary: Ares Chief Executive Officer Michael Arougheti discusses the deployment of artificial intelligence and second-quarter results. "We want to be horizontally diversified across all the different private market asset classes," he tells Bloomberg Television. Arougheti also comments on the state of private equity. "The institutional demand for private credit is probably accelerating right now because they're seeing spreads widening and they're seeing capital leave the market and feel like there's an opportunity to come in and take share," he says. (Source: Bloomberg)

title: FIFA Fallout: UEFA's Stance Shows Lack of Consultation, says Former England Player Eni Aluko
title_cn: 国际足联余波：前英格兰球员埃尼·阿鲁科表示，欧足联的立场表明缺乏协商
summary: Former England Women's National Football Team player and sports investor, Eni Aluko, says UEFA's plans to boycott FIFA tournaments if President Gianni Infantino proceeds with his plans to sell stakes in a new commercial entity to investors shows a "lack of consultation" by football's world governing body. FIFA’s proposal plans to transfer major commercial and tournament operations into a new entity called FIFA Forward Enterprise. The vehicle would initially be valued at about $20 billion, with FIFA seeking to raise as much as $4.2 billion from outside investors while retaining sole control through majority representation on its board. Aluko discussed the fallout from the FIFA proposal with Francine Lacqua on "The Pulse". (Source: Bloomberg)

title: Kospi Surges 18% on AI Optimism
title_cn: 人工智能乐观情绪推动 Kospi 飙升 18%
summary: Tech stocks rallied as a rebound in chipmakers carried into Friday, with an unprecedented 18% surge in South Korea’s Kospi Index leading the charge. Bloomberg's Neil Campling reports. (Source: Bloomberg)

title: Engie Flags Lower Renewable Additions Due to Slow US Permitting
title_cn: 由于美国审批缓慢，Engie 表示可再生能源发电量下降
summary: French utility Engie SA’s growth in renewables and battery storage will temporarily slow this year as the Trump administration continues to take time in delivering permits in the US despite growing power demand, Chief Executive Officer Catherine MacGregor said.

title: Pentagon Seeks $18.2 Billion in War Funds for Interceptors
title_cn: 五角大楼寻求 182 亿美元的战争资金用于拦截机
summary: The Pentagon’s $67 billion request for emergency funding this fiscal year includes $18.2 billion to replace the US’s most advanced Patriot missile, Navy Tomahawks and the Army’s high-altitude interceptor known as Thaad, according to documents provided to Congress.

title: Trump Puts Immunity From Probes Over His Fight for Blanche
title_cn: 特朗普为布兰奇之争免除调查
summary: President Donald Trump’s desire to avoid the kinds of criminal prosecutions he faced the last time he left office has become the biggest impediment to getting his own attorney general pick confirmed by the US Senate.

title: Hamas, Israel to Hold Firm in Gaza Unless Other Moves First
title_cn: 哈马斯和以色列将坚守加沙，除非先采取其他行动
summary: Hamas said it agreed to disarm as long as Israel withdraws from Gaza and agrees to the establishment of an independent Palestinian state, conditions that dent the prospects of a revival in the protracted peace process.

title: Trump Blames Minnesota Cyberattack on Governor, Not Iran
title_cn: 特朗普将明尼苏达州网络攻击归咎于州长，而不是伊朗
summary: President Donald Trump blamed Minnesota state officials with whom he has feuded for cyberattacks on multiple water systems there, despite reports that officials suspected Iranian involvement in the disruptions.

title: Sinking in Polls, Farage Plans Week of Attacks on Immigration
title_cn: 民意调查失败，法拉奇计划发起一周针对移民的攻击
summary: Under attack over his finances and dropping in the polls, Nigel Farage’s right-wing Reform UK party is aiming to turn public attention to his supporters’ core concern: immigration.

title: Trump Redistricting Foe to Leave Post Under Fire From Right
title_cn: 特朗普重新划分选区，让敌人在右翼攻击下离开岗位
summary: President Donald Trump celebrated on social media after Indiana State Senate president Rodric Bray said he wouldn’t stand for re-election to the post, after Bray defied him over redistricting US House seats to give the party an advantage in this year’s midterms.

title: Chicago School Board Budget Relies on Uncertain State Funding
title_cn: 芝加哥学校董事会预算依赖于不确定的国家资金
summary: The Chicago Board of Education approved a roughly $10 billion budget that relies on uncertain state funding and rolls back proposed teacher layoffs.

title: Inside Trump’s Deal to Reshape Alaska
title_cn: 特朗普重塑阿拉斯加协议的内幕
summary: A mining deal by the Trump administration and a 211-mile road have pitted Wall Street against Alaska residents fearful of the environmental impact. But not everyone is against the Ambler Road project. (Source: Bloomberg)

title: China’s London ‘Super Embassy’ Plan Survives Court Challenge
title_cn: 中国伦敦“超级大使馆”计划经受住了法庭挑战
summary: The UK’s approval of a new Chinese embassy in London was lawful, High Court judges ruled in a decision that could mark the end of a long-running saga that’s strained Britain’s ties with China.

title: Everybody’s Business: Kalshi’s Fight to Bet on Elections
title_cn: 每个人的事：卡尔希押注选举的斗争
summary: On this episode of the Everybody's Business podcast, Bloomberg reporter Denitsa Tsekova joins Max Chafkin and Stacey Vanek Smith to unpack how prediction markets' bets on elections can affect the actual outcome, what the state of Wisconsin is doing about it and where the Trump administration stands on the matter. (Source: Bloomberg)

title: Gulf States Look to Protect Oil Trade Amid Renewed Strikes
title_cn: 海湾国家希望在新一轮罢工中保护石油贸易
summary: Ellen Wald, senior fellow at the Atlantic Council, said that countries on the Arab peninsula are unified in their sentiment against Iran in light of recent attacks leveled against the Gulf States. Wald and Leslie Vinjamuri, president & CEO of the Chicago Council on Global Affairs, broke down the latest in the conflict between the United States and Iran and how it is impacting the global oil market, as prices rise after recent strikes. Vinjamuri said that at this point in the war, it is 'well past' the point where the goal is regime change in Iran and now the US must settle for stability in the Strait of Hormuz. (Source: Bloomberg)

title: US Push for 100 Years of B-52s Sees Delays, Cost Runup, GAO Says
title_cn: 美国政府问责局称，美国推动 B-52 服役 100 年的计划出现延误、成本上升
summary: A $21 billion Air Force effort managed by Boeing Co. to upgrade the engines, radar and communications of the iconic B-52 bomber is seeing cost growth and delays during early development, according to a congressionally mandated audit.

title: House Democrats Seek Answers on Faster Access to Trump’s Posts
title_cn: 众议院民主党人寻求有关更快访问特朗普帖子的答案
summary: House Democrats are opening an inquiry into a plan by President Donald Trump’s media company to offer faster access to posts on its social media platform to Wall Street firms in exchange for a fee.

title: Ukraine Says It Attacked Lukoil’s Volgograd Refinery
title_cn: 乌克兰称袭击了卢克石油公司伏尔加格勒炼油厂
summary: Ukraine struck one of Russia’s largest oil refineries, threatening to disrupt fuel supplies again as strikes on the country’s downstream industry resumed.

title: Burnham to Give Mayors Some Control Over Income Tax Revenues
title_cn: 伯纳姆将赋予市长对所得税收入的一定控制权
summary: Andy Burnham said he would give mayors in England a share of the income tax generated in their regions as part of the new UK prime minister’s drive to move political and economic power out of Whitehall.

title: Spain Says Half of Immigrants Entering African Enclave Have Left
title_cn: 西班牙称进入非洲飞地的移民有一半已经离开
summary: More than half of the 50,000 people who illegally crossed the Spanish border between an African enclave and Morocco have now left, Spain said as it faces mounting pressure from Europe to quickly reassert control.

title: Indian Arms Sales to Israel a Human Rights Risk, Amnesty Says
title_cn: 国际特赦组织称印度向以色列出售武器构成人权风险
summary: India has provided thousands of military components to Israeli companies supplying parts to the armed forces, raising risks that New Delhi is supporting what Amnesty International calls an ongoing genocide against Palestinians, the human rights watchdog said in a report.

title: South Africa Finance Watchdog Issues Record Fines in Crackdown
title_cn: 南非金融监管机构在打击行动中开出创纪录的罚款
summary: South Africa’s finance regulator imposed record penalties as it sought to deter misconduct and boost trust in the industry.

title: India Student Protesters Beat Modi's WhatsApp, X Playbook With Instagram Memes
title_cn: 印度学生抗议者用 Instagram Memes 击败莫迪的 WhatsApp、X Playbook
summary: As a wave of student-led protests swept India last week, Satvik Soni spent hours buried on Instagram broadcasting protest locations, explaining detainees’ rights and calling on demonstrators to report police misconduct. His tersely worded posts quickly racked up tens of thousands of views.

title: Trump and Allies See Big Financial Gains, While Polls Signal Trouble Ahead
title_cn: 特朗普和盟友看到了巨大的经济收益，而民意调查则预示着未来的麻烦
summary: The split-screen has created a perilous moment for Trump and Republicans.
